review.note: Summary drafted in M41b from the two cached leads, which say what the party was and where it went and very little else. Its part in the wartime governments is not in this record because no source here states it.

summary: The Evolutionist Party, formally the Republican Evolutionist Party, appeared on 24 February 1912 as the first secession from the Portuguese Republican Party, and was led by António José de Almeida. In 1919 it was one of the two conservative republican parties that merged into the Republican Liberal Party, which came first at the election of 1921.
